tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the DharmikStudio catalogue (Hindi, Hinglish or English). Returns ids, titles and page URLs; pass an id to fetch for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full public record of one work or place: description, every episode with its link, key points, sources and (for articles) the text.

tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: Ranked search with optional filters. language: hi, en, gu, ta, bn, te...; type: audio, video, series, course, article, book, reel; category: a slug from list_categories.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Structured details of one work (series, course, book, article, video) or a temple/place: episodes or lessons with listen/watch links, length, access, sources, other language versions and the podcast RSS feed for audio series.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The catalogue's categories and subcategories, with counts and browse pages.

tools.name: new_releases
tools.description: Works published, or given new episodes, in the last N days (1-30), newest first. section: listen, watch, read or learn (optional).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
